name: Baskin All-In the Family
source:
Baskin All-In: the Family is a harem, drama that steps into darker themes along it's visual novel routes but kiss your sister and everything will be alright.

A father's funeral brings home a struggling actor once again. After a decade in the big city, the hometown on decline is far worse. The rural community is falling apart but that's where the family remains. 

Your older sister, Beatrice, moved out on her own and teaches in the next town. Your mother Selena lives in a house with your two younger sisters. Bryerly runs the family Farm and Tulip does the accounting for half the county.

But Tulip has a plan that can lead to you choosing how you want to change the lives of everyone you know. The two of you can skip town, or ensnare every women you know.

Fall in love in Plainview County. Escape or transform it.

[From [url=https://thesugarray.itch.io/baskin-all-in]itch.io[/url]]
